[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested considering purchasing a Ridacard for prepaid travel on buses, trams, and some taxis in Edinburgh.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ridacard costs £3 for the card, with various travel costs: single bus fare £1.70 (peak) or £1.40 (off-peak), daily pass £4.50, weekly pass £20.50, monthly pass £82.50.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ridacard can be purchased at Travelshops, newsagents, online, or on the Airlink 100 Bus.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Travelshop at Haymarket Station is open Monday to Saturday 9:00 am to 5:30 pm and Sunday 10:00 am to 5:00 pm.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Travelshop accepts cash, credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), and debit cards.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Travelshop services include Ridacard sales, bus and tram tickets, travel information, and brochures for attractions.
